title: English File Elementary — verbs and daily life

words.def: To move or travel from one place to another
words.ex: I go to the bazaar on Sundays.
words.coll: go home, go to school, go for a walk

words.def: To move towards or arrive at the place where the speaker is
words.ex: Come here and look at this.
words.exTm: Bu ýere gel we muňa seret.
words.coll: come in, come from, come back

words.def: To rest your mind and body with your eyes closed, usually at night
words.ex: Children need to sleep eight hours a night.
words.exTm: Çagalar gijesine sekiz sagat uklap bilmeli.
words.coll: sleep well, go to sleep, sleep late

words.def: To get knowledge or skill in a subject by studying or practising
words.ex: I want to learn English for my job.
words.exTm: Işim üçin iňlis dilini öwrenmek isleýärin.
words.coll: learn by heart, learn English, learn from mistakes

words.def: To pay attention to a sound or to someone who is talking
words.ex: I listen to music on the bus.
words.coll: listen to music, listen carefully, listen to the teacher
